title: fix(app-shell): a new field's API name follows the label on every keystroke, not only the first (objectui#7615)
body:
Fixes #7615

## The defect

Typing a field label one character at a time left the field permanently named after
its **first letter**. `Health Score` produced the API name `h`, and no later keystroke
moved it — nor did editing the label again afterwards.

The card's measurement is a **contrast**, and that is what makes it diagnosable: the
same target string reached two ways gave two answers.

| how the label was entered | API name |
|---|---|
| `fill("Health Score")` — one input event | `health_score` ✅ |
| `pressSequentially` — one event per key (a person typing) | `h` ❌ |

## Cause

`deriveNameFor` answered *"is this API name still auto-generated?"* by
**pattern-matching the name itself** against the placeholder shapes `nextFieldName()`
and the type default emit (`field_N` / `TYPE` / `TYPE_N`, spelled with placeholder words here — the literal
angle-bracket form does not survive GitHub's body sanitizer) — and its own first
rename **destroys the very shape it gated on**. `field_10` → `h` on the `H`, after
which `h` no longer looks auto-generated, so every later keystroke was ignored.

That is also why no existing test saw it: one `change` event derives once and lands on
the right answer. Only a *second* change event can observe the gate that the first one
broke.

## The fix

Record who owns the API name instead of re-reading the answer off a string this
feature rewrites. Same posture the object/app create surfaces already use
(`CreateViewDialog`'s `nameTouched`, `useCreateDerive`'s touched set): **the derivation
yields the moment the value has an authoritative source.**

- `'label'` — this inspector wrote the name from the label; the next label change may
  move it again.
- `'author'` — the author typed the name into the API name box; nothing the label does
  moves it again.

The three boundaries, unchanged in intent from #2260 and per the PM ruling on #7615:

1. **new + untouched → re-derive on every label change.** The `'label'` record carries
   the "still auto" answer forward across the rename that used to erase it.
2. **already named (i.e. saved) → never re-derived.** Such a name matches no
   placeholder shape and carries no record, so it is in neither state and stays locked.
3. **author edited the API name → locked.** Recorded on *every* keystroke in the API
   name box, including one the existing guards **reject** (cleared, unchanged, or
   colliding) — a rejected keystroke is still an authorial edit, and the label must not
   resume overwriting what they are typing. This closes the one case a string test
   cannot decide: a hand-typed `field_9` is the author's value, not `nextFieldName()`'s
   output, and the two are the same string.

The record is stamped with the object as well as the field name — one inspector
instance serves every selection, and selections cross objects.

### Bounded and deliberate: what "unsaved" means here

The record lives on the mounted inspector, so a reload always falls back to the
placeholder check. What it buys is exactly the session in which the author is still
creating the field. It does **not** end at the 1.5 s draft auto-save
(`useDraftAutoSave`) — deliberately: if that counted as "the save", per-keystroke sync
would be impossible by construction, since it fires during every typing pause. A
tighter signal would need the host to tell the inspector "this field is persisted",
which is a new prop — outside this card's clause-② `no`. Flagged for the PM rather
than done here.

**No exported type, symbol or published signature changed** (clause-② `no`):
`apiNameOwnerRef`, `objectName` and `recordedOwner` are all local to the component.

## Evidence

All commands run from the repo root; exit codes captured by redirecting first, never
through a pipe. Union re-run at the final commit **`864cd7e4c`**.

**Red before the fix** — `pnpm exec vitest run …/ObjectFieldInspector.apiNameSync.test.tsx`
against unmodified `main`, `EXIT=1`, `Tests 4 failed | 3 passed (7)`, reproducing the
card's own measurement:

```
FAIL … > keeps syncing on EVERY keystroke, not just the first one
Expected the element to have value:  health_score
Received:                            h
```

The 3 that passed pre-fix are the controls: the single-`change` paste, the saved-field
case, and the CJK label.

**Green after** — `EXIT=0`, `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 7 passed (7)`.

**No regressions** — whole inspectors directory, `EXIT=0`,
`Test Files 66 passed (66)`, `Tests 764 passed | 1 skipped (765)`.

**Ablation** (mutation proven on disk by anchor-count flip + `git hash-object`;
restored under a `trap … EXIT INT TERM` with `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH`, proven
by state — `git diff HEAD` empty and the hash back to the HEAD blob
`e2569f375b95df7f07ce43dadff3506c98e70e75`). Each guard is independently load-bearing:

| mutation | anchor count | result |
|---|---|---|
| drop `owner === 'label' \|\|` | 1 → 0 | `Tests 3 failed \| 4 passed` — `keeps syncing on EVERY keystroke…`, `tracks a label the author keeps editing…`, `stops the moment the author edits the API name themselves` |
| drop `if (owner === 'author') return null;` | 1 → 0 | `Tests 1 failed \| 6 passed` — `stops even when the author typed something SHAPED like an auto name` |

**Gates**, all `EXIT=0` at `864cd7e4c`:

- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` — BEFORE: `EXIT=1`,
  `❌  2 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change adds no changeset:`
  · AFTER: `EXIT=0`,
  `✅  3 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s): .changeset/7615-field-api-name-follows-label.md.`
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` — `✅  No changeset declares a `major` bump.` (declared `patch`)
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` — `✅ … OK (scanned 6362 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary).`
- `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers` — `✅ … OK (4316 tracked source file(s), 2597 test-named; …)`; the population count rose by one against the pre-stage run, i.e. the new test file was actually measured rather than skipped as untracked.
- `pnpm check:vi-mock-inherit` — `✅ … OK (4316 tracked source file(s) …)`
- `pnpm check:designer-field-key-parity` — `designer-field-key-parity: OK`
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/app-shell` — `EXIT=0`,
  `Tasks: 30 successful, 30 total` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`)
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run lint` (the package's real CI command) —
  `EXIT=0`, `✖ 2886 problems (0 errors, 2886 warnings)`; all warnings pre-existing.
- Repo-wide `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config . --format json` — **4314** files
  linted, 93 pre-existing errors, **none of them in the three files this PR touches**.

Also corrected: the existing sibling test titled *"…live, per keystroke"* fired exactly
one `change` event. Retitled to say what it measures (`…in one input event`), with a
pointer to the new file. Its assertions are unchanged — it is the control half of the
contrast above, and it was green before and after.
